I read the whole file: four theorems, with a main proof `kSPGLProper` that has two branches (π = false and π = true). The branches already share the helpers `exists_units_pow_three`, `exists_forall_pow_three_ne` and `exists_cube_of_projImage_eq`. What remains duplicated is the short sequence "get ω, get δ, apply the cube lemma, rewrite with det_diagGL, contradict hδ". That is the same call pattern in two branches of a single proof, and the branches differ in the subgroup (the kernel of the power map versus all of Kˣ) and in the membership proofs. Extracting it would only move duplicated branch structure into a helper, which the rubric says is insufficient.

I grepped the repository for the helper names. The other `exists_units_pow_three_ne_one` lemmas are in LinearCoverLarge.lean, Radicals.lean and DecompSetupSplit.lean, and they prove a different statement (∃ t, t^3 ≠ 1). The file ThreeNineCatThreeUnitaryTwo.lean has an `exists_units_pow_three` that needs card = 4, so it cannot replace the target's lemma, which assumes 3 ∣ card Kˣ. Two of those other lemmas, in LinearCoverLarge.lean and Radicals.lean, have near-identical rootsOfUnity-counting proofs. Both lie outside the target file, so I did not report them. No duplicated proof machinery inside the target is justified under this rubric. The Lean text was not compiled.
